IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives McDermott, Cody, Kenney, Grant and Chase

Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing the sale of alcoholic beverages on state ferries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to liquor licenses issued to entities providingconcession services on vessels owned by the Washington state ferries;and adding a new section to chapter 66.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any entity providing concession services on a vessel which is theproperty of the Washington state ferries may obtain an appropriatelicense under this chapter to serve spirits, beer, or wine on thevessel. The entity's license shall allow the entity to serve spirits,beer, or wine on any vessel on which the entity is contractuallyobligated to provide concession services. The entity need not obtaina separate license for each vessel for which it provides concessionservices.
